annotations.text:
Rebuilt in the industrial / engineering register — the Manufactt and Industrial X reference class, with structure borrowed from Ecofrost (spec sheets, ownership of the technical story) and ColdHubs (hard-number stat grids).

No gradients, no glows, no mesh, no grain anywhere. Flat colour, hard rules, square corners, technical line drawing.

Type: Outfit for display, Inter for text, IBM Plex Mono for every label, tag, unit, reference code and table header.

Colour: warm paper #F4F5F3, ink #14181D, hairline rules #D5D9DE. Brand green/blue/amber survive only as small data and status accents.

FIG. 1 is a real elevation drawing with numbered leader-line callouts, not an illustration.

Motion is functional only:

• 140–160 ms colour and border changes on hover for cells, rows, segmented controls and nav links
• Segmented controls invert to solid ink when selected
• Bars ease to their new width over 500 ms
• Mobile menu slides down 220 ms

No entrance reveals, no ambient loops, nothing decorative — so PNG/PDF export is now safe at any moment.

Everything in [BRACKETS] is a real fact I did not have — names, contacts, institution, mentor. Fill those in before this goes anywhere public.

All telemetry and impact figures come from the simulated hardware service and are labelled as such on every page.
